edits.text: 1. PURCHASE PRICE. At Closing, the Seller shall transfer the Shares to the Buyer, and the Buyer shall pay the Seller [amount and currency to be agreed] (the “Purchase Price”) in full by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by the Seller, subject only to any purchase price adjustments expressly agreed in this Agreement. The Buyer’s payment obligation is not subject to a financing condition.

2. CLOSING. Closing shall occur on a mutually agreed date no later than thirty calendar days after execution of this Agreement (the “Closing Deadline”). The only conditions to Closing are receipt of mandatory legal or regulatory approvals and tender of customary transfer deliverables, in each case as specifically listed in Schedule [Closing Requirements]. At Closing, the Seller shall deliver duly executed transfer instruments, certificates for the Shares where applicable, and the other listed documents necessary to effect transfer of the Shares, against payment of the Purchase Price. Each party shall use reasonable efforts to obtain required approvals and provide its required deliverables promptly. No party is required to close in violation of applicable law. If Closing has not occurred by the Closing Deadline, either party that is not in material breach may terminate this Agreement by written notice, provided its breach has not caused or materially contributed to the failure to close. Termination does not affect accrued rights or remedies for a prior breach. The parties may extend the Closing Deadline by written agreement.

3. REPRESENTATIONS. The Seller represents at signing and at Closing that the financial statements identified in Schedule [Financial Statements], covering the periods specified there, fairly present in all material respects the financial position and results of operations of the issuer for those periods in accordance with [agreed accounting standard], subject to the specific exceptions identified in the agreed disclosure schedule by reference to this representation. The financial statements, accounting standard and disclosure schedule shall be agreed and attached before execution.

4. INDEMNITY. The Seller shall indemnify the Buyer for actual losses, liabilities and reasonable external costs incurred by the Buyer arising from liabilities of the issuer attributable to facts, events or circumstances existing before Closing, solely within the categories expressly defined in Schedule [Covered Pre-Closing Liabilities] and not fairly disclosed in the agreed disclosure materials identified in Schedule [Disclosure Materials]. A disclosure is sufficient only if it identifies the nature and scope of the relevant liability in reasonable detail. This indemnity survives Closing for twelve months. Claims notified in writing before expiry, stating the factual basis and a reasonable estimate of loss to the extent then known, survive until finally resolved. The Seller is liable only for aggregate covered losses exceeding one percent of the Purchase Price, and only for that excess; aggregate liability under this indemnity shall not exceed ten percent of the Purchase Price. No loss may be recovered more than once, and recoveries shall be reduced by amounts actually recovered for the same loss from insurance or third parties, net of reasonable recovery costs. The Buyer shall take reasonable steps to mitigate covered losses. The Buyer shall promptly notify the Seller of third-party claims; delay does not defeat an otherwise timely claim except to the extent the Seller is materially prejudiced. The Seller may assume the defence with competent counsel reasonably acceptable to the Buyer after acknowledging indemnity responsibility, subject to the agreed limitations. The Buyer may participate at its own expense and may retain control where a material conflict exists or non-monetary relief against it or the issuer is sought. Neither party may settle a claim without the other’s consent, not to be unreasonably withheld, conditioned or delayed; the Buyer need not consent to a settlement that imposes an admission, non-monetary obligation or unreimbursed payment on it or the issuer, or fails to provide a full release. Nothing in this clause excludes or limits liability to the extent it cannot lawfully be excluded or limited.

Purchase Price, currency and any adjustments remain to be agreed.

Agree the covered liability categories and the closed set of disclosure materials before signing. Confirm the remedies applicable to representation breaches and their interaction with this indemnity; this clause does not establish an exclusive-remedy regime.

All outstanding commercial terms, schedules and disclosure materials must be agreed before signing, and no agreement is binding until the complete definitive document is executed.
